No cashiers at checkout is a new approach. As is having a light on at the register you are not operating and taking the customers who arrived after the person waiting at the aisle with the light.
Such wonderful customer service.  They listen and make sure that your shopping experience is a positive one.

The one taking care of me today was John, the manager
he was very nice, attentive, and helped me earned more rewards for the food I was purchasing for my cats (I have 16 cats, so I spend a lot on them)
He was very, very and I mean VERY nice in explaining how I can earn more rewards next time I purchase cat items on the register using the app, without me asking !
and his attitude…omg!, he just made my day!
Thank you John, I appreciate you!
We need more people like you!
I’m definitely coming back to this store and hopefully, I’ll see you again!
Keep up the great work and the passion you have for the business.
My cats will know about you when I get home and tell them about my experience 🫶🏻
Remember they don't keep orders for longer than 3 days

Would love if this location actually cared about getting the cats adopted. Came in yesterday to visit the adoption center and was told to come back in 24 hours because the cats are getting acclimated. Traveled back here today and was told the same thing once again, refusing to let potential adopters in. So unprofessional!

I absolutely love this PetSmart!! I live on the south side of Chicago and I will not go to any other petsmart. I make the drive. When I took my new pup in, I was taken care of by Mike, he helped me pick a cage and helped me with accessories like training treats and a comfortable collar ETC. at check out, I was taken care of by the manager John. He was awesome! Very knowledgeable, he answered all my questions with no hesitation! I bought a book that was full of coupons and the book paid for itself AND  John went as far as looking thru the book with me to cut coupons out so I can use them at check out!! Who goes above and beyond like that?! This petsmart does!! Now yesterday I went in for a fish and Josh is sooo smart!!! He knows so much about fish and shared interesting fact about some there. He helped my husband pick out a tank and accessories and my family left so happy! He was so kind! I called today with a concern and the day manager Jack Angel was nothing short of the rest of my experiences!! He was awesome! He helped me and guided me through my question. This petsmart is amazing, I am a loyal customer to this location!
Thank you for leaving feedback. Please reach out to us at (773) 342-1300 so we may identify ways to improve your experience.
Came in for stuff for my tortoise came out with a betta fish the water was so dirty I felt bad for them PETS SMART DO BETTER !!!!

Do not take your dog here if you want a loving and conscientious groomer. While I was waiting to check in my dog, I heard the way they were speaking to these other adorable little dogs. They complained that the dogs weren’t  cooperating and they were making everything take longer. They badmouthed owners saying that they don’t understand how their dogs behave when they’re being groomed. This may all be true. However, this is their profession and they didn’t seem to enjoy dogs, care for dogs, let alone love dogs. I tried to keep an open mind as I proceeded to check in my dog (and hoped I would have a better groomer). We had a lengthy consult where I acknowledged that there were some matting on her belly and possibly on her legs, but that I didn’t want her shaved down all over. It was okay to go shorter or to shave her down on her tummy and chest and to take it shorter on her legs. It was a very elaborate conversation. Just as I was about to get home, I got a call saying they would have to shave her down. This is exactly what I said I did not want. I wish they would’ve just said that before I left and saved me the joy of driving in traffic. It felt like they were just looking for the easiest solution that required the least amount of skill. They also said my dog didn’t handle brushing. I found this strange because she has been going to the same groomer her whole life and we’ve never had any complaint. The only reason we even tried PetSmart was out of  desperation because our other groomer had moved. This PetSmart location was everything I feared it would be. It’s a big box place that will not take careful care of your beloved pet. They will also do bait and switch when it comes to grooming. Also, they put on the manager and he provided nothing to compensate for the bait and switch or inconvenience. Stay away!

The groomers are nice but every single time we bring our dog to the pet salon in this Petsmart, she comes back with a kennel cough. It has happened on multiple occasions, so I would be careful of that and even if your dog has the vaccine, that doesn't guarantee protection against all strains of the virus. We will be looking for another groomer in the area.

We went in to buy cat food but I brought a betta fish container up to the front because it was particularly cloudy with green at the bottom. The store associate was friendly and summoned the manager to discuss, who then began to tell us how it was an issue with the single cup being cloudy and that cleaning day is on Saturday (currently Monday). It is very much not a singular cup issue (see pics) even though that is the only one that had the green. Multiple of them are clouded and the fish looked lethargic. I do not believe proper cleaning or safety protocol is being followed for these animals and I do believe they are being left out on the wall far too long with minimal care or attention. I judge a PetSmart as a former employee by how well the fish are treated because they typically are the most abused animals in any pet store. The manager at this location particularly was trying to tell me about PetSmart cleaning guidelines, but I know from my time working in a store that if an animal's enclosure was unclean and unsafe, it didn't matter when the scheduled cleaning day was because the animal's health and safety comes first. I will not be shopping at this location again based on management's dangerous attitude towards a concerned customer regarding the health of an animal.

Brought my senior cat in for a nail trim and brush. This place may be okay for dogs but I wouldn’t recommend for cats. The grooming area is one room with six high tables a few feet apart, so large dogs were right there adding anxiety for my cat. The groomer picked my cat up by the scruff multiple times to flip him over and manoeuvred him pretty roughly, the brushing was vigorous and I could tell he was in pain as he’s pretty sensitive in his old age. I’m sure that was just how the groomer was trained to handle cats, no hate to her, and she did get lots of fur out, but I know adult cats shouldn’t be picked up entirely by their scruff and it didn’t seem like a good pain-free environment for a cat.

0/10 - I would never recommend this pet hotel.

I reserved and prepaid for a private suite months in advance for my dog over the busy Fourth of July weekend because I wanted to make sure he would be comfortable while I was out of town.

When I arrived to check him in, I was told, "We're out of suites." Excuse me? If I reserved a suite months ago, why wasn't one reserved for me? I was then told by the manager, Terry, that suites are "first come, first serve." That completely defeats the purpose of making a reservation. If reservations don't actually reserve anything, then don't advertise them as reservations.

The explanation only got worse. Terry then said they were remodeling and she had only been told the night before. I asked why no one contacted me immediately so I could make other arrangements before a major holiday weekend. Her response was, "I'm telling you now." That passive-aggressive attitude was completely unacceptable. "Now" was three hours before I was leaving the state, when finding another boarding facility was nearly impossible.

The only "solution" offered was an $18 credit for extended. That's insulting.

What makes this even more frustrating is that I've spent thousands of dollars with this PetSmart. My dog boards here, gets groomed here, sees the Banfield veterinarian here, and I regularly purchase food and supplies here. I spent over $200 boarding my dog last week, another $100 on food, and this stay was going to cost nearly $350. This company has benefited from my loyalty for years, and this is how a long-term customer is treated.

I understand that renovations, emergencies, and mistakes happen. What I cannot accept is the complete lack of communication, the failure to honor a reservation made months in advance, the dismissive attitude, and the refusal to provide a meaningful solution.

Terry's handling of this situation turned what could have been an unfortunate inconvenience into a terrible customer service experience. Good managers take ownership, communicate proactively, and work to make things right. That didn't happen here.

This experience has completely destroyed my trust in PetSmart. After years of loyalty and thousands of dollars spent, I will be taking my business elsewhere. I won't be boarding my dog here, buying pet supplies here, using the grooming services, or visiting the veterinary clinic associated with this location again.

If your pet's accommodations are important to you, I strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

I have filed a formal complaint with the Better Business Bureau and I called customer support on the phone and spoke with Jasmine she was the only pleasant part of this entire experience. Thank you for opening my complaint and escalation.

Okay, Okayyy...I’ll continue to go to the location in Evanston, clearly, judging by how you wave off customers during the checkout process and ‘close up shop’ when it’s my turn that you don’t need my hard earned money here 🤷‍♀️. Luckily, I love my RES and she really needed a new heat & uvb lighting kit. So disappointed but enlightened and so glad I didn’t ask a staffer to retrieve that 75 gallon tank and stand. Thank you 😊

It's impressive how a business can make customers feel unwelcome. The red-haired, "slightly" chubby employee clearly missed the memo on basic courtesy. A simple question was apparently too much to handle, and I was met with rudeness and laughter instead. If that's the standard management accepts, it explains everything. Never again.

My vet told me to pick up some prescription powder food from a Banfield Petsmart and the lady at the Banfield desk was extremely rude and unhelpful. The petsmart employee was nice, but I would recommend going to any other Petsmart before going here.

I’ve been using them since I found my cat in 2010, but I will be switching to a different pet store because that was an AWFUL experience, especially when my cat is extremely sick.
The store is nice and clean. I just don't like when pet owners  are rude to others.

The people there are really helpful,  and answering every question we have about the food for our cat winston.
Thank you very much for everything.  We will go back!!
Great store closed to my house
Hello, thank you for your positive review. We're always happy to help! Have a great day!
Hi, wow, thank you for rating us so many stars! We're thrilled that you had such a positive experience! We hope that you'll consider us again in the future.

Went in 4/27 for cat food. Heard dogs somewhere barking their vocal cords off. Have not been in to a Pet Smart that boards dogs! This habitat was disgusting. Large dogs boarded in a 2x5 wire cage. Poor older dog stuck in a room. No food. No water. Sara comes out who runs the place after I hung messages about inhumane treatment.
DO NOT BOARD animals here!!! Can you imagine how the cats are treated?
Note going to CEO. I called ANIMAL CONTROL!!!
Too busy to visit the cats for adoptions without a wait. Manager blew us off without speaking to us.
Nice staff!
Grooming team is very rude and unprofessional doesn’t seem to have any customer curtsey and politeness , bad customer service highly recommend you don’t visit here for grooming
Hi, thank you for taking the time to leave us this great rating!

They need to do a better job at updating their inventory to reflect what they really have in stock. Wasted my evening driving to 2 different locations only to find out that they did not have in stock what was clearly listed as in stock online.
Thank you for taking the time to rate us here at PetSmart. Have a great day!

I had a terrible experience here thanks to the manager, John.

I was purchasing cat food, as I have here monthly for years

The employee at the register asked me to input my phone number. I did and my account came up immediately.

Next they asked me to scan an app on my phone. My battery was dying and I didn’t have the app installed so I politely declined.

At this point John, who was already chirping orders at this employee shouted out to  him to remind me to ask about scanning the app.

I declined a second time. John then began to bark at this employees again about wasting my time asking about the app, despite the fact that he had just given that exact instruction.

The employee was just following his commands, and his attitude was rude, and sarcastic and unnecessary.

I’m sure if I was more patient we could have figured it out. However I felt really badly for the other employee, John’s attitude was not appropriate for a work place.

I decided to leave to find my cat food elsewhere. And John said sarcastically to me ‘fine,we were just trying to help you save money anyway’

I just wanted to purchase cat food. I wasn’t interested in downloading apps, or saving money. I most certainly was not interested in listening to a manager berate an employee that was just doing their job. As I was walking out I heard John continuing to berate the other employee

This is one of the poorest examples of leadership I’ve seen in my life.

I apologize to that other employee for the situation.

I look forward to speaking with the store managers and corporate regarding this incident.

I would hate to think that this is the way Petsmart trains their employees, especially employees with managerial duties.

Here’s a photo of John, continuing to give this employee a hard time.
John the manager is very professional. Extremely helpful. Definitely great service. Helped me save money and earn money on any future purchases for my pets.Definitely a real one.
Hi, thanks so much for rating us so high! We hope you have a great day!
I don't spend as much time there as I used to. Do a lot more online pickup. But I've never had an issue and whenever I'm there it's always in and out.
No pets,  just parakeets, wouldn't spend that kind of money for a bird
Thank you for reaching out to us with such a great rating of PetSmart! We strive to provide an excellent experience, and your opinion plays an integral part in making this happen! All the best!
Fabulous! We are so excited for all of those stars. Thank you!

We adopted a cat today and needed to grab a hard-shell carrier. We bought one but didn’t have a way to assemble it before our adoption appointment. We asked the cashier Jim if we could borrow a screw driver and he offered to assemble the carrier for us. We’re super grateful for his help and enjoyed our experience, great customer service

We had such a great experience with the PetSmart Hotel for our golden retriever! The staff was incredibly kind, professional, and genuinely caring. You can tell they truly love animals and treat them like their own.

One thing we really appreciated was that they allowed us to bring in his own food and snacks. That made a huge difference for us and helped keep his routine consistent while we were away. It gave us real peace of mind knowing he was comfortable and well cared for.

The pricing was very reasonable compared to other places we looked at, and the service exceeded our expectations. Great value, great communication, and great care.

Highly recommend — we’ll definitely be back! 🐾
Very clean, nice friendly  informative employees.

I know these ppl don’t care about animals and ppl and just want a paycheck. The times I’ve gone always felt rushed . Just yes and no answers. I purchased a bird and it passed unfortunately, I called to see if anything can be done, I had told them I had it for 21 days.The employee, (name starts with E ) I can’t remember but said yes definitely we can do something ,come in and we’ll see . Ok cool, came in and no hello , how can I help you, just a you called about the bird? Went to go ask a supervisor then came back to say we can’t do anything. But you had just said you can and to come in. He said no I never said that. Ok thanks for wasting my time this is why I called. I should’ve known , when the bird was purchased the manager felt annoyed in having to ring it up, and it felt very rushed didn’t suggest anything didn’t say anything just here’s your receipt. Thank you for a memorable day.

I had talked to a guy named Esteban about my bird that I had purchased from here, he passed away within 21 days. I called and asked if I could do anything about it, mentioned the 21 days, and he said to come in because they can do something. I bring the bird, the receipt, everything. I get there and they tell me they can’t do anything about it because he didn’t know it was 21 days and there’s a 14 day policy for birds. I asked for even a half refund, any medical records, they gave me nothing. Awful customer service. If I could rate no stars I would.
Your great rating means a lot to us at PetSmart, and we appreciate you taking the time to leave us this review! Take care!
I came here at night to get some bird food quickly, it was very chill and everything is very organized, unlike some other pet stores out there. This is my go-to store for my bird's food.
Love this store and this location. The staff is genuinely helpful, and Taylor was out of this world helpful—so sweet and attentive. Great vibes all around, and my dachshund is a fan too 🐾✨ …
Great staff, particularly the Manager John. He welcomed me and my puppy and gave us a few coupons. Thanks.
Hi, it's great to see such a high rating! Thank you for reviewing us!

Stan the manager literally BEST customer service I have experienced at any petsmart location. I came in looking for an online order and unfortunately got cancelled. He explained to me the 72 hour policy. No problem! I’ll just go grab the items. I asked if he could honor the 20% discount that I got the items online for. He did! And he explained the benefits of having the app. Which I downloaded. Overall great experience.
Super friendly and helpful staff

Had a disappointing experience with the pet hotel and grooming salon. The staff was not friendly and were very impatient when I dropped my dog off for her stay, barely even letting me say bye. When I called to check on her during her stay, I was put on hold for 30 minutes and had to call back twice to get through to someone where they gave a generic “she’s fine” answer. She had a bath on the morning I came to pick her up and her feet were still noticeably dirty and she has dandruff that she didn’t have before.  Overall do not feel safe leaving my dog here and will have to figure something else out next time I go out of town.
Thank you for the positive review!

I placed an order while shopping at another store in the lot. I left the store earlier than I thought I would, & went to PetSmart to pick up my online order. I utilized the Curbside pickup option as I had my 15 month old with me. I spoke with the manager John, & explained to him that I did just place the order 20 minutes ago - however I was wondering if it were available for me to pick up. He stated that he would grab it for me, & bring it right out.

I was humbly grateful, & appreciative of the service he provided me. Happy Holidays to John & his team!
Big thanks for the fabulous review! Don't hesitate to reach out and let us know if there's anything we can do for you! Best regards.
Hi, thanks for the all of the stars! Please don't hesitate to reach out to us if you need any further assistance.
We love stars! Thanks so much!

My dog has bladder stones and I gave them instructions and things to look for. For example, straining while trying to pee could be an emergency meaning the stone is stuck. They have called me 2 times to fill me in on how he’s doing. Terry talked me through protocol and procedures for what they do if they are concerned for a pet. She took the time to walk me through everything. I am all the way in Florida with my 11 year old dog who is my whole world and of course I worry but knowing they have OPEN and honest communication when it comes to the health of my dog… this is HUGE. I appreciate their phone calls and full transparency and attention to the details. Not every visit has been perfect but I just got off the phone with Terry and wanted to make a review online because I went from panic attack from listening to the voicemail to calm and reassured. Thank you!
Hi, thank you for taking the time to leave us this great rating!
This is a nice store to shop at, and thank goodness for the parking lot.
Hi, thank you for rating us! We appreciate you taking the time to do this, and hope you have a great day!
Thanks for your positive review! The whole team here at PetSmart strives to provide a positive experience. Wishing you a great day!

I’m writing this months later because I’m still stunned by how bad my experience was at their grooming facility and I was also just quoted over $200 to fix the damage they did to my dog’s coat. I brought my golden retriever in for the full package: ear cleaning, nail trim, bath, and groom. If you have a golden, DO NOT BRING THEM HERE.

The haircut alone was the worst I’ve ever seen, but the bigger issue is that they simply didn’t do the services I paid for. When I picked her up and walked her around the store for treats, I realized she smelled worse than when I dropped her off. Her ears were still full of wax, her nails hadn’t been trimmed, her coat felt dirty, and the grooming itself was shockingly uneven. I bathe my dog weekly, so she is never in that condition, and I initially assumed maybe they’d forgotten to rinse a product or had used a shampoo with a funky smell.

I went back into the salon and asked if she had been bathed. The employee flatly said yes. I tried to give them the benefit of the doubt and asked to smell the shampoo they used, thinking maybe the scent had changed, but it clearly didn’t match what was on my dog. When I asked again, three employees came out and responded with condescending, dismissive attitudes. Their red-haired manager rolled his eyes before walking me over for a refund.

For the record, I wasn’t even looking for a refund, it was a gift card. I just wanted to understand how a grooming appointment could go so wrong.

When I got home and bathed her myself, the water ran nearly black, something that has never happened before. Her paw pads had been shaved unevenly, her coat was damaged, and the professional groomer who corrected it asked if a toddler with scissors had gotten to her.

I contacted corporate at the time and never heard back.

I have never once left a negative reviews for any business ever, but when it comes to my dog, I will absolutely speak up. Please don’t take your pets here.
